_note: All user-facing one-liners live here. Edit freely; no code changes needed. {dist} = distance to the nearest alert in degrees, {date} = a dayObs, {n} = a count.
title: Has Rubin seen JWST?

status_line.JWST not up: JWST never got above 20° from Rubin. Nothing to see.
status_line.no alerts: No new alerts from Rubin this night.
status_line.covered, loose match only: Something within 20″ of JWST. Probably not it; check by eye.

counts_note: New Lasair objects = first detected this night. Not Rubin's total alerts: re-detections of known objects also send alerts and aren't counted here.
alerts_empty: No Rubin alert has matched JWST yet. This table starts with the first one.
sky_caption: Equatorial coordinates, RA increasing to the left. Turquoise heat map represents nights with new alerts within 1° cell, but may not accurately track the density of total alerts.
